_about: ARES-X EVA budget assumptions sheet. Edit values here, not in code. Every number is an engineering approximation; 'verify' marks values worth checking against a primary source before the final slides.

rest_floor_W.source: Floor on the Pandolf resting term; applying G to it underestimates basal metabolism (ICES-2025-129 caveat)

stop_work_note.source: Stationary geology work at a science stop, ~Apollo station work (~800-1000 BTU/h)

max_slope_deg.source: No-go limit (NASA xEVA concept, NaviGATOR ICES-2024, JSC CSRM)

pace_to_peak_limit.source: Operational rule: on steep pitches the astronaut slows down so the metabolic rate stays at the 2000 BTU/h peak limit; such legs are flagged 'paced'

downhill_rule.source: Downhill grade treated as level ground in the metabolic term (conservative; Pandolf has no valid negative-grade term)

terrain._source: eta = Pandolf terrain factor (1.0 blacktop, 1.1 dirt road, 1.2 light brush, 1.5 heavy brush, 1.8 swamp, 2.1 loose sand) mapped to Mars ground; [best, nominal, worst]. speed_factor scales the Apollo speed; boxwork 0.75 reproduces the team planning value of ~40 min/km incl. margin.

cases._source: Uncertainty band. margin multiplies walking time (MIT SEXTANT field tests under-predicted time and energy by 20-30%).

h_fg_MJ_per_kg.source: Latent heat of water evaporation at suit temperature

reserve_fraction.source: Team assumption: keep 25% of each consumable at return

min_sun_elev_deg.source: Team assumption: whole EVA in daylight (visual navigation, no GPS)

q_elec_W.source: Fan, pump, radio, HUD heat inside the suit - placeholder until Marwane's battery model

u_insulation_Wm2K.source: Suit insulation conductance in 700 Pa CO2 (MLI is degraded by gas conduction)

t_inner_K.source: Inner suit temperature held by the cooling garment

h_conv_Wm2K.source: Free convection in Mars CO2, order of magnitude 0.5-2

view_factor_sky.source: Standing person sees half sky, half ground

suit_power._source: Suit battery: placeholder until Marwane's battery model. Draw = suit_thermal.q_elec_W + any heater power.

battery_Wh.source: EMU-class suit battery (~26.6 Ah at 16.8 V) - verify (Marwane)

reserve_fraction.source: Same 25% reserve rule as O2 and water

rover._source: Unpressurized LRV-class rover the astronaut can drive; it powers and charges the suit while docked and relays the suit radio to the base. Placeholders (Marwane to refine battery/radio).

v_max_mps.source: ~5 km/h on rough Mars ground (Apollo LRV averaged ~8 km/h on the Moon)

v_slope_loss.source: Speed falls linearly to 50% of v_max at the rover's max slope

max_slope_deg.source: Driving limit on loose slopes (LRV rated 25 deg; conservative)

avoid_boxwork.source: 1-2 m boxwork ridges are not drivable: park at the edge and walk in

rolling_coeff.source: Wheel rolling resistance on loose regolith

drive_efficiency.source: Battery to wheel (motors, gears); no regeneration downhill

hotel_W.source: Rover avionics + relay radio while on

battery_Wh.source: LRV had ~8.7 kWh (2 x 121 Ah, 36 V)

seated_metabolic_W.source: Driving seated in a suit (~500 BTU/h, Apollo LRV crews)

suit_charge_W.source: Suit battery charging from the rover while docked

margin.source: Time margin for driving (detours around rocks)

comms._source: Line of sight on the DEM (with Mars curvature) plus a maximum range. Simplified coverage model, not a radio propagation calculation. Placeholder antenna heights (Marwane).

suit_rover_range_m.source: Low-power suit radio to the rover access point (Apollo EVA-to-LRV relay ~ km class) - placeholder (Marwane)

rover_base_range_m.source: Rover-to-base link, larger than the 3x3 km map - placeholder (Marwane)

navigation._source: Illustrative position-uncertainty model for the simulation (radius in metres, linear growth, NOT a statistical confidence level). No beacons or satellites.

base_fix_m.source: Habitat is a surveyed point (HiRISE / DEM co-registered)

rover_drift_frac.source: Rover dead reckoning drift ~2% of distance driven (MER/MSL wheel + visual odometry order of magnitude)

walk_drift_frac.source: Astronaut dead reckoning ~3% of distance walked (pedestrian inertial / step counting, order of magnitude)

time_drift_m_per_min.source: Extra drift while on foot, also when standing still (sensor bias) - assumption

dock_m.source: Within 3 m of the rover = docked / aboard: astronaut takes the rover's position estimate

dock_add_m.source: Extra uncertainty when copying the rover's estimate

climate._source: Representative Gale sol near equinox, shaped to REMS ranges. Replace with a REMS/MCD hourly table via --climate when Almila has it.

solar_const_Wm2.source: Mean solar irradiance at Mars distance

transmittance.source: Global (direct + diffuse) transmittance for dust opacity tau ~0.5

t_air_max_K.source: REMS: up to ~+6 C in the afternoon

t_sky_factor.source: Effective sky temperature = 0.8 * air temperature (dusty CO2 sky)
